About.title: About
About.courseText: This project was built as part of the RS School React course (2026 Q2) — a free, community-driven course teaching modern front-end development through hands-on, real-world projects.
About.projectText: Swagger/OpenAPI UI is an editor and interactive REST client for OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. It lets you paste or write a schema, validate it, browse its endpoints, execute real requests against any public API, and review your request history with detailed analytics.
